run_time_func_benchmark: run time_func to benchmark a callable function and print average execution time in milliseconds
test_time_func_with_iterations: test time_func with a custom number of iterations to measure function performance
review_time_func_warmup: review time_func to understand its warmup phase before timing the benchmarked function
summarize_time_func: summarize time_func which times a function over multiple iterations and prints results
refactor_time_func_for_return: refactor time_func to return the measured time instead of only printing it
